flowchart TD
  subgraph E["Lancement"]
    bin["bin/gollum"]
    ru["config.ru"]
    lib["lib/gollum.rb"]
  end
  subgraph S["Serveur"]
    app["lib/gollum/app.rb"]
    hp["lib/gollum/helpers.rb"]
    vp["lib/gollum/views/page.rb"]
  end
  subgraph FR["Interface"]
    tpl["lib/gollum/templates/page.mustache"]
    lay["lib/gollum/templates/layout.mustache"]
    js["lib/gollum/public/gollum/javascript/app.js"]
    ed["lib/gollum/public/gollum/javascript/editor/gollum.editor.js"]
  end
  bin --> lib
  ru --> app
  lib --> app
  app --> hp
  app --> vp
  vp --> tpl
  tpl --> lay
  lay --> js
  js --> ed
explication: bin/gollum ou config.ru démarre l'application Sinatra (app.rb) qui lit le dépôt git du wiki. Les vues Ruby remplissent les templates mustache, et les scripts JavaScript fournissent l'éditeur côté navigateur.
